name: citytracker.ai
description:
CityTracker provides a free, read-only query interface to New York City's public real-estate and property data — the datasets from NYC and NY State open-data portals, cleaned and joined so they can be searched together.

Coverage spans all five boroughs (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island) and includes: Department of Buildings (DOB) construction permits and job filings; DOB and HPD building and housing violations, complaints, litigations, and vacate orders; ACRIS property documents — deeds, mortgages, liens, and the parties on them; tax lots (PLUTO/BBL) with owner, year built, zoning, land use, units, and assessed value; certificates of occupancy; facade compliance filings (FISP / Local Law 11); 311 requests; HPD registrations; property assessments; tax lien sales; and resolved company and representative (owner and contractor) records. It also covers NY State liquor licenses and retail food stores.

Use it to answer questions like: Who owns this building or address? What permits and construction have been filed here? Does this property have open DOB or HPD violations? Which homes recently sold, and which were built before a given year? Which buildings are flagged as structurally compromised or need repairs? What are a lot's zoning, size, and assessed value? Who is the mortgage lender on a deed?

Well suited to real-estate research, property due diligence, construction and contractor lead generation, ownership and title research, code-compliance monitoring, and market analysis. Read-only, sourced from public datasets.

_published_faq.name: How do I add citytracker.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add citytracker.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://citytracker.ai/api/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is citytracker.ai MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, citytracker.ai scores 96/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the citytracker.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: citytracker.ai provides these MCP tools: describe_table, list_tables, overview, and query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to citytracker.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to citytracker.ai in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator, and Evaneos.
citytracker.ai does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
citytracker.ai is developed by CityTracker. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
